# Capital Rift Recipe Generator

> Unofficial, community-maintained calculator for Capital Rift local food trends and recipe taste matching. Current mechanics model: 2026-09-23 / v413.

## Use the tool

- [Recipe generator](/): Enter a restaurant chunkId, generate its three deterministic local trends, and search for 12 best-found recipes.
- [Methodology](/methodology): Learn how to find a chunkId and audit the normalization, trend generation, scoring, and search process.

## Documentation

- [Full mechanics reference](/llms-full.txt): Formulas, taste axes, verified fixture, search behavior, limitations, and reporting guidance.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of the public website routes.

## Community and source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/mrawsky/capitalrift-recipe): Source code, tests, fixtures, and project history.
- [Report a mismatch](https://github.com/mrawsky/capitalrift-recipe/issues/new): Share a changed game mechanic or reproducible calculation problem.

## Notes

- Recommendations optimize verified taste match only, not cost, inventory, preparation time, station compatibility, or profit.
- Recipe names are generated by this tool and do not come from the game.
- This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Capital Rift or its developer or publisher.
